maria_smith: ACME asked for a clear compliance add-on price sheet to include in the POC SOW: 7yr audit retention, KMS vs HSM options, HIPAA+BAA. Need discount scenarios for 12/24 month commits. @kevin_deals can you lead?
ajay_patel: POC window is ~6 weeks. Theyll start on hosted and may switch to Dedicated post-POC. We need conservative estimates for procurement.
lisa_se: Drafted cost structure (rough numbers):
- baseline audit logs: 30d included
- extended retention (per GB/mo): 1yr $0.11, 3yr $0.065, 7yr $0.032
- KMS: customer-managed KMS supported, no monthly platform fee, envelope encryption model
- HSM: dedicated HSM option (FIPS/Tamper): $14,500/mo + $0.025/request; one-time attestation/setup $11,000; lead time 4-8 weeks
- HIPAA package: onboarding (BAA + config) $7,500 one-time + $1,900/mo enhanced logging/retention
- SOC2 report delivery: $11,000/yr
- Data residency surcharge: +5% infra if dedicated region required
Sample SKUs for quote: 
``
RDW-AUD-7Y: audit-retention-7yr $0.032/GB/mo
RDW-HSM-MON: hsm-cluster $14,500/mo
RDW-HSM-SET: hsm-setup $11,000 one-time
RDW-HIPAA: hipaa-package $7,500 onboarding + $1,900/mo
RDW-SOC2: soc2-report $11,000/yr
```
ajay_patel: Important: HSM provisioning is not instant. Can we offer KMS-with-strict-controls as a POC substitute so they can demo key management without waiting weeks?
lisa_se: Yes. POC pattern: use customer KMS and tightened access controls/logging; call out that this is not hardware-backed HSM and does not provide attestation. Add note in SOW.
kevin_deals: Deal desk guidelines: standard add-on discounts up to 20% for 12mo depending on ARR. HSM discounts limited due to fixed support costs. We can offer a POC credit up to $15k applied to first invoice. For committed spend >= $200k ARR we can approach 25-30% off retention SKUs and waive HIPAA onboarding. Need final billing entity and payment terms to finalize.
maria_smith: Kevin, can you produce two quote variants: 
1) POC quote: 6-week, KMS-simulated HSM, waive HIPAA onboarding, apply POC credit where eligible.
2) Commit quote: 12mo (and optional 24mo) with committed discounts, HSM option (setup + monthly), SOC2 + HIPAA bundle.
kevin_deals: On it. I need: expected monthly log ingest (GB), primary billing entity, payment terms (net30/net45), and whether they will use CMK or require HSM.
acme_it: Estimates: Ingest ~2TB/mo. Archived ~25TB/mo after compression (~3:1). Billing: ACME Corp (US). Payment: net30. We prefer HSM but open to CMK for POC. Can you show 12 vs 24mo delta?
lisa_se: CMK technical note to include: we use envelope encryption; customer key never leaves their KMS. For HSM we provide hardware attestation and tamper-resistant key storage; detail key lifecycle and rotation in the clause.
kevin_deals: Legal looped. @legal_team please confirm HSM contract clauses + sample BAA language so we can include in quote.
legal_team: Will produce HSM clause + BAA sample. Need 24-48 hours for review.
security_ops: Created quick-compliance checklist: BAA required, dataflow diagram, encryption in transit+at-rest, list of sub-processors. ETA 2 business days. Checklist link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/1782200455
maria_smith: Action items: Kevin - draft both quotes and POC SOW (EOD tomorrow). Lisa - attach CMK/HSM clause + lead times. Ajay - confirm POC schedule with ACME. Security - fill questionnaire and upload.
acme_it: Also: can you show what happens to cost if we compress/aggregate logs differently? procurement wants sensitivity table.
kevin_deals: Will add a sensitivity table: low/expected/high ingest scenarios, 12 vs 24mo pricing, and committed discount columns. For 24mo we can typically extend another 5-10% discount depending on ARR; will show that.
maria_smith: Great. If legal signs off on HSM clause quickly we may close the PO next week. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
kevin_deals: Looping legal now, will post drafts back to thread when ready. :thumbsup:
